q: Why did God destine the believers in advance for adoption?
a: God destined the believers in advance so that he would be praised for his glorious grace.

q: By what have believers been saved?
a: Believers have been saved by God’s grace.

q: For what purpose has God saved and raised up believers?
a: God has saved and raised up believers so that in the ages that are coming he might show them the great riches of his grace.
We have been saved by grace through faith as God’s gift.
No believer should boast because he is not saved by his own works.

q: By what means do all believers have access to the Father?
a: All believers have access to the Father by means of the Holy Spirit.

q: What gift was given to Paul?
a: The gift of God’s grace was given to Paul.

q: What did Christ give to each believer after his ascension?
a: Christ gave each believer grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

q: What must not be suggested among believers?
a: Sexual immorality, impurity, and greed must not be suggested among believers.

q: What fruit of the light is pleasing to the Lord?
a: The fruit of goodness, righteousness, and truth is pleasing to the Lord.

q: Of what is the husband the head, and of what is Christ the head?
a: The husband is head of the wife, and Christ is head of the Church.

q: How does Christ sanctify the Church?
a: Christ sanctifies the Church holy by the washing her of water with the word.

q: What hidden truth is demonstrated by the joining of a man and his wife?
a: The hidden truth about Christ and his Church is demonstrated by the joining of a man and his wife.

q: What does Paul ask that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give the believers?
a: Paul asks that God will give them peace and love with faith.
